"""Generate and save the frozen-instance RoboLab jugs-on-shelf trajectory."""
from __future__ import annotations

import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session

OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
RACK = "large_storage_rack"
JUG1, JUG2 = "utilityjug_a01", "utilityjug_a02"


def rot(q):
    w, x, y, z = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
    return np.array([
        [1 - 2*(y*y + z*z), 2*(x*y - z*w), 2*(x*z + y*w)],
        [2*(x*y + z*w), 1 - 2*(x*x + z*z), 2*(y*z - x*w)],
        [2*(x*z - y*w), 2*(y*z + x*w), 1 - 2*(x*x + y*y)],
    ])


def qmul(a, b):
    aw, ax, ay, az = np.asarray(a, float)
    bw, bx, by, bz = np.asarray(b, float)
    return np.array([
        aw*bw - ax*bx - ay*by - az*bz,
        aw*bx + ax*bw + ay*bz - az*by,
        aw*by - ax*bz + ay*bw + az*bx,
        aw*bz + ax*by - ay*bx + az*bw,
    ])


def qaxis(axis, angle):
    axis = np.asarray(axis, float)
    axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
    return np.r_[np.cos(angle/2), axis*np.sin(angle/2)]


def main():
    s = Session("jugs_on_shelf", instance="/app/instance.json")
    p = s.primitives()
    from robolab.core.task.predicate_logic import _untransformed_hull, in_opentop_container, in_contact

    def pose(name):
        return s.object_pose(name)

    def center(name):
        pos, quat = pose(name)
        c = _untransformed_hull(s.world, name).centroid.detach().cpu().numpy().copy()
        return pos + rot(quat) @ c

    def bbox_center(name):
        corners, mid = s.world.get_bbox(name, env_id=0)
        return np.asarray(mid.detach().cpu().numpy() if hasattr(mid, "detach") else mid, dtype=float)

    def local_point(name, point):
        pos, quat = pose(name)
        return pos + rot(quat) @ np.asarray(point, float)

    def move(pos, quat, speed=.17):
        if s.episode_done:
            return
        try:
            err = p["move_ee"](np.asarray(pos, float), quat, speed=speed, max_dq=.06, tol=.009,
                                rot_tol=.08, max_steps=300)
        except Exception:
            print("move failed at", np.round(s.ee_pose()[0], 3), "joints", np.round(s.joint_positions(), 3),
                  "goal", np.round(pos, 3))
            raise
        print("move", np.round(pos, 3), "err", err, "actual", np.round(s.ee_pose()[0], 3))

    def open_hold():
        p["open_gripper"](steps=18)
        p["hold"](steps=6)

    q0 = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
    close2 = rot(pose(JUG2)[1])[:, 0]
    q2 = p["top_down_quat"](p["yaw_for_closing_dir"](close2[:2]))
    # World rotation that lays a neck-held upright jug toward the rack front.
    q_lay = qaxis([-1, 0, 0], np.pi/2)

    # Find grasp heights that actually lift each object in this physics instance.
    # Every probe resets to the exact frozen initial state; only the final pass is recorded.
    def probe(name, local_z, q, tool_z_lift=.15):
        s.reset()
        pp = local_point(name, [0, 0, local_z])
        grasp = pp.copy()
        if name == JUG2:
            # The side-lying jug's narrowest section is its cap. Lower the finger tips
            # to the cap's mid-height so the pads engage more than its upper rim.
            grasp[2] = .050
        print("probe", name, "local z", local_z, "point", np.round(grasp, 3),
              "initial root", np.round(pose(name)[0], 3), "bbox center", np.round(bbox_center(name), 3))
        move([grasp[0], grasp[1], max(.36, grasp[2] + .15)], q)
        open_hold()
        move(grasp, q, speed=.07)
        p["close_gripper"](steps=20)
        p["hold"](steps=5)
        closed_root = pose(name)[0].copy()
        closed_center = bbox_center(name).copy()
        contact = bool(in_contact(s.world, name, "gripper", env_id=0))
        print("closed", name, "root", np.round(closed_root, 3), "bbox center", np.round(closed_center, 3),
              "contact", contact, "finger", s.gripper_angle())
        ee = s.ee_pose()[0].copy()
        move([ee[0], ee[1], ee[2] + tool_z_lift], q, speed=.11)
        p["hold"](steps=10)
        lifted = bbox_center(name).copy()
        root = pose(name)[0].copy()
        contact2 = bool(in_contact(s.world, name, "gripper", env_id=0))
        dz = float(lifted[2] - closed_center[2])
        print("lift test", name, "bbox", np.round(lifted, 3), "root", np.round(root, 3),
              "dz", round(dz, 3), "contact", contact2)
        return contact2 and dz > .055 and np.all(np.isfinite(lifted))

    probes = {JUG1: [(0.250, q0), (0.230, q0), (0.250, p["top_down_quat"](.55))]}
    chosen = {}
    for name in (JUG1,):
        for local_z, quat in probes[name]:
            if probe(name, local_z, quat):
                chosen[name] = (local_z, quat)
                print("selected grasp", name, local_z)
                break
        if name not in chosen:
            raise RuntimeError(f"no liftable grasp found for {name}")

    # Now run the fixed sequence from the frozen state and record only these actions.
    s.reset()
    s.record_start()
    placements = {JUG1: np.array([.35, -.56, .20]), JUG2: np.array([.35, -.56, .20])}

    def pick_place(name, local_z, quat, transit_z):
        if s.episode_done:
            return
        pp = local_point(name, [0, 0, local_z])
        grasp = pp.copy()
        if name == JUG2:
            grasp[2] = .050
        move([grasp[0], grasp[1], max(.36, grasp[2] + .15)], quat)
        open_hold()
        move(grasp, quat, speed=.07)
        p["close_gripper"](steps=22)
        p["hold"](steps=7)
        before = center(name)
        ee, _ = s.ee_pose()
        print("picked", name, "center", np.round(before, 3), "ee", np.round(ee, 3),
              "contact", bool(in_contact(s.world, name, "gripper", env_id=0)))
        move([ee[0], ee[1], transit_z], quat, speed=.12)
        p["hold"](steps=10)
        lifted = center(name)
        ee, _ = s.ee_pose()
        rel = lifted - ee
        print("carry", name, "center", np.round(lifted, 3), "rel", np.round(rel, 3))
        # Clear the tabletop clutter first, then approach the shelf at a high front
        # waypoint before lowering the jug onto its middle shelf.
        move([ee[0], ee[1], .55], quat, speed=.12)
        move([.35, -.25, .55], quat, speed=.15)
        move([.35, -.38, .55], quat, speed=.12)
        goal = np.array([.35, -.424, .27])
        print("edge placement", name, "goal", np.round(goal, 3))
        move(goal, quat, speed=.08)
        print("release test", name, "center", np.round(center(name), 3),
              "inside", bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, name, RACK, env_id=0)))
        open_hold()
        print("released", name, "center", np.round(center(name), 3),
              "inside", bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, name, RACK, env_id=0)), "status", s.status())
        if not s.episode_done and not bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, name, RACK, env_id=0)):
            # Nudge the edge-positioned bottle across the table/rack gap.
            move([.35, -.32, .12], quat, speed=.10)
            p["close_gripper"](steps=12)
            move([.35, -.44, .12], quat, speed=.06)
            p["open_gripper"](steps=14)
            p["hold"](steps=12)
            print("after edge nudge", name, np.round(center(name), 3),
                  bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, name, RACK, env_id=0)))

    pick_place(JUG1, chosen[JUG1][0], chosen[JUG1][1], .48)

    # Stand the second jug upright while its base sweeps against the tabletop. This
    # avoids the large torque that makes a direct cap lift slip. Then lay it toward the
    # rack front so its centroid enters the rack while the fingertip frame stays outside.
    if not s.episode_done:
        R0 = rot(pose(JUG2)[1])
        u = R0[:, 2]
        axis = np.cross(u, np.array([0., 0., 1.]))
        axis /= np.linalg.norm(axis)
        cap = local_point(JUG2, [0, 0, .265])
        grasp = cap.copy(); grasp[2] = .050
        move([grasp[0], grasp[1], .36], q2, speed=.12)
        open_hold()
        move(grasp, q2, speed=.07)
        p["close_gripper"](steps=22)
        p["hold"](steps=6)
        anchor = s.ee_pose()[0].copy()
        print("jug02 cap grasp", np.round(anchor, 3), "contact", bool(in_contact(s.world, JUG2, "gripper", env_id=0)))

        q_up = q2
        for theta in np.linspace(np.pi/12, np.pi/2, 6):
            q_up = qmul(qaxis(axis, theta), q2)
            pos = anchor.copy()
            pos[2] = anchor[2] + (.28 - anchor[2]) * np.sin(theta)
            move(pos, q_up, speed=.07)
        p["hold"](steps=12)
        print("jug02 stood center", np.round(center(JUG2), 3), "root", np.round(pose(JUG2)[0], 3),
              "contact", bool(in_contact(s.world, JUG2, "gripper", env_id=0)))

        # Raise while upright, carry to the same rack-front staging point, and rotate
        # the held jug so its body extends along -Y into the rack.
        ee = s.ee_pose()[0]
        move([ee[0], ee[1], .55], q_up, speed=.10)
        move([.35, -.38, .55], q_up, speed=.14)
        qlay2 = qmul(q_lay, q_up)
        move([.35, -.38, .55], q_up, speed=.14)
        move([.35, -.38, .55], qlay2, speed=.07)
        p["hold"](steps=8)
        rel = center(JUG2) - s.ee_pose()[0]
        goal = placements[JUG2] - rel
        print("jug02 laid rel", np.round(rel, 3), "contact", bool(in_contact(s.world, JUG2, "gripper", env_id=0)),
              "goal", np.round(goal, 3))
        move(goal, qlay2, speed=.07)
        print("jug02 release test", np.round(center(JUG2), 3),
              "inside", bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, JUG2, RACK, env_id=0)))
        p["open_gripper"](steps=18)
        p["hold"](steps=20)
        print("jug02 after release", "center", np.round(center(JUG2), 3),
              "inside", bool(in_opentop_container(s.world, JUG2, RACK, env_id=0)), "status", s.status())
    actions = s.record_stop()
    print("recorded", actions.shape, "status", s.status())
    s.save_trajectory(actions, OUT, meta={"generator": "gen.py", "placements": {k: v.tolist() for k, v in placements.items()},
                                          "grasp_local_z": {k: float(chosen[k][0]) for k in chosen}})
